sections.heading: Company profile
sections.body:
AirMark is the national sign supply leader focused on improving productivity and profits for the sign, aerospace, and outdoor advertising industries through vinyl cutting, printing, labeling, and stenciling equipment.

Industry: Manufacturing · Size: <$50M · Products: Vinyl Cutting Machines, Printers, Sign Supplies, Blades & Bits, Inks & Ribbons, Vinyl & Media

sections.heading: Qualification summary
sections.body: AirMark Corporation scores 16 of 100 (tier disqualified) at 90% confidence. Nothing was found for event engagement and pain-point alignment, so those score zero rather than being estimated.

sections.heading: Tedlar angle
sections.body: No durability claims were found in their public copy, so the opening has to establish the problem before the product. Lead with the cost of premature graphic failure rather than with film chemistry.

sections.heading: Comparable accounts
sections.body: Closest known-good accounts: Mactac (33% similar on vinyl, printing, sign, print); Drytac (19% similar on print, vinyl, media, sign); Avery Dennison Graphics Solutions (18% similar on vinyl, graphic, dennison, window). Reference the comparable account by name on the call — a converter is far more persuaded by what a peer does than by a spec sheet.

sections.heading: Who to talk to
sections.body: No decision-maker resolved from public sources. Target titles for this ICP: VP Product, VP Product Development, VP Innovation, VP Research and Development, Director of R&D.

sections.heading: Gaps and risks
sections.body:
• Event engagement: Confirming attendance at one more show would add points.
• Pain-point alignment: Each additional durability theme found adds 5 points.
• Flags on the record: size third party estimate
